A Sleepy Trick..description: A fairie's tranquil song drifts through the air. INT save or fall asleep (disadvantage for each Wound you have). You wake to find your weapons replaced with flowers and 1 Wound healed.
A Sleepy Trick..name: A Sleepy Trick.

Adventurer's Bane..description: Looks almost identical to Bloodshrooms. Does not heal. Instead has a hallucinogenic effect: sees allies as enemies for 1 round upon eating.
Adventurer's Bane..name: Adventurer's Bane.

Cauldron..description: Each round a magical ladle targets 1 hero to push into the cauldron (DC 10 DEX save). 1d20 fire damage/turn.
Cauldron..name: Cauldron.

Explosive Tunnels Gas..description:
Each hero may make skill checks, saves, or otherwise be creative to navigate in the dark (DC 12). Roll twice:

0 Failures. How lucky! You gain inspiration (the ability to reroll any single die, once).

1 Failure. Gas makes you dizzy, -1 speed until you leave the sewers.

2 Failures. Fumesick. Suffer 1 wound, poisoned, and -1 speed until you leave the sewers.
Explosive Tunnels Gas..name: Explosive Tunnels Gas.

Fetid Stench..description:
Heroes must make a STR save each time they traverse from one location to another or be Poisoned while in that area. The DC increases as they go deeper.

The Path Below: DC 6. Echoing Cistern: DC 8. Feeding Chamber: DC 10. Explosive Tunnels: DC 12. Guttermaw's Lair: DC 14. Shrine to the Rat God: DC 16.
Fetid Stench..name: Fetid Stench.

Glacial River..description: EXTREMELY cold. Soaks through clothing if walked through or pushed in. -1 speed until dried out.
Glacial River..name: Glacial River.

Pill Bugs..description: Stepping on the litter on the floor or speaking above a whisper causes pill bugs to drop from the ceiling onto their heads and try and suffocate them. DC 12 DEX save or Grappled, Blinded, and suffocating: Take 1 Wound/round until you escape. Fire, bright lights, or dealing 10 or more damage in a single turn could also cause a bug to flee.
Pill Bugs..name: Pill Bugs.

Poison Vent..description: A crack forms in the earth, spewing toxic fumes all around (STR save or take 1/2 LVL Poison damage and become Poisoned for the next 2 traveling encounters). Bearer of Trueflame has advantage.
Poison Vent..name: Poison Vent.

Rat Bite..description: If touched, a rat emerges from the remains and bites the hero (1 damage, DC 10 STR save or poisoned until you heal any amount of HP).
Rat Bite..name: Rat Bite.

Rootbreaker Pit..description: The Rootbreakers will attempt to entangle the heroes and pull them down (DC 10 DEX save or Grappled and pulled down into the pit).
Rootbreaker Pit..name: Rootbreaker Pit.

Sand Madness..description: Heroes must make a WIL save or suffer sand madness as they are compelled to ceaselessly stare at the Golden Pyramid's beauty. They have disadvantage on attacks and are unable to take reactions for 3 hours (until the end of the next encounter).
Sand Madness..name: Sand Madness.

Sleepy Oasis..description: Drinking the water heals HP, but causes drowsiness (1 HP/gulp; more than 4 gulps: fall asleep for an hour afterward, suffering 1 Wound for sleeping in the heat).
Sleepy Oasis..name: Sleepy Oasis.

Spear of Lightning..description: Touching the spear grants the Charged condition, and +1d6 lightning damage on attacks for 1 minute. 1/day.
Spear of Lightning..name: Spear of Lightning.

Thorn Briars..description: If pricked, suffer 1d4 damage and blood begins to be drained. Finesse check to remove thorn, repeat damage until success (or magically healed).
Thorn Briars..name: Thorn Briars.
